title: DCLab Code: who made each decision, the grade's turn; task list, slash commands, archive, today's spend
request: Continue without stopping, and capture, record and store data for training the six models.
plan: Say who made each decision so a builder never takes the app's for the person's
Four everyday features with page tests

decisions.decision: by: person or app on every decision record
decisions.why: R&D 32.34's review found a stop's automatic denies stored as the person's gold labels

decisions.decision: a grade carries its turn number
decisions.why: R&D's shaper rewrites timestamps, so time cannot match a grade to its turn

change: engine decisions with by; feedback turn; TodoWrite checklist; slash suggestions from the SDK's init; archive; today's spend.

findings.defect: automatic decisions recorded like the person's
findings.scenario: Stop while a step waits: a deny recorded with no sign it was the app's
findings.cause: denyAll and the abort handler wrote the same record as the person
findings.fix: by: app on them, by: person on the person's

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every server, unit and page test passes
measurements.result: 35 server and unit tests and 4 page tests in Chromium passed

outcome: Every decision says who made it, each grade its turn, and four everyday features are in the page.
lessons: Record provenance at the source; a reader can only guess it later
